mobile_scope: Chromium device emulation; no physical-device claim
method: tools/check_kaleidoscope.py over a local Python HTTP server, headless Edge and native CDP touch emulation.

coverage.desktop: Static initial example; 3/16 symmetry; three palettes; mouse drawing; whole-stroke undo; clear; keyboard controls; 1080x1080 PNG dimensions and nonblank decoded content.
coverage.lifecycle: Pointer cancel, circle exit, blur, hidden page, pagehide, resize and parameter changes discard only the unfinished stroke; idle drawing schedules no frames.
coverage.render_cache: Reused and fresh canvases produce identical PNGs across parameter changes, same-count stroke replacement, active/cancelled strokes, undo, resize and example. Warm drawing traces fewer than half as many line segments as a fresh draw.
coverage.mobile: 390x844 DPR3 and 844x390 Chromium emulation; DPR2 cap; scroll before/after drawing; single-finger drawing; tap without a stroke; system cancellation; second-finger cancellation and subsequent drawing.
coverage.limits: 60 complete strokes fit; excess input preserves old work and shows guidance; undo releases capacity. Node tests cover total and per-stroke point budgets.
coverage.fallback: No JavaScript, unavailable config and unavailable Canvas retain preview, disabled controls and source links.
coverage.gallery: 28 works; home and artwork03 card open the playable page; reciprocal links between fireworks and kaleidoscope.

python_suite.skip_reason: Optional existing Tk font-boundary desktop check was not enabled.

other_checks.fireworks_browser_regression: 6/6 groups passed after adding the navigation link.
other_checks.desktop_formula: Two Python tests verify cardinal coordinates and unchanged desktop scale, y direction and line style; Node geometry matches generated Python fixtures. A third regression verifies export stability under platform floating-point roundoff; fixture coordinates use 9 decimal places, runtime geometry keeps full precision.
other_checks.existing_gallery_smoke: 28 cards, featured/search, controls, GIF and 390px mobile layout passed without JavaScript errors.

limitations: Mobile checks emulate Chromium; physical Android and iOS devices were not tested.
Safari and Firefox were not tested.
Browser and desktop share mirror geometry, but their rendering and interfaces differ.
Test-group seconds describe checker runtime, not rendering performance.
Drawings are kept only in the current page; users must download PNG before refreshing.
